name: PR: template closing > on its own line (like a wrapped ) )
input:
template <typename TFirstRowType, typename TSecondRowType, typename TThirdRowType, typename TFourthRowType>
class TRowsProcessor {};
expected:
template <
    typename TFirstRowType,
    typename TSecondRowType,
    typename TThirdRowType,
    typename TFourthRowType
>
class TRowsProcessor { };
note: comment-18340323: wanted the closing '>' of a wrapped template on its own line, analogous to how '()' wraps. Not configurable in clang-format. https://a.yandex-team.ru/review/13704587/details#comment-18340323
